messages.subject: discover the username automagically
parts:
I just did this

devtools::install_github("magrittr")

and thought "Wouldn't it be great if that gave as an error:

You need to give me "user/package" (not just "package"). Try:

   install_github("smbache/magrittr")

as I found that on github.

In TexMate, I've got a Ruby command that finds github links for projects and returns them as a url (for building links).

Something like that I think would help many people each day, who remember "roxygen2",  but not the username it is sitting under etc.

messages.subject: Re: discover the username automagically
parts:
Was thinking something pretty crude, like

uri = "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=magrittr+language:R&sort=stars&order=desc"
x = RCurl::getURL(uri, useragent = "RCurl", referer = "http://www.ed.ac.uk")
y = jsonlite::fromJSON(x)
z = y[3]
z$items$full_name[1]
[1] "smbache/magrittr"
